context: deploy — the published page reads the same to an agent as to a browser. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: clones_presentational
checklist.description: Carousel/marquee loop clones carry no text nodes, alt="", no href, no role/aria; the rendered DOM word count of the block equals the authored slide text counted once.

checklist.name: document_first_listing
checklist.description: The index-backed band is delivered with one authored row per listed item (card text) plus a label-list row; the block renders from rows and uses the index only for non-text fields and top-up (reference/ai-readability.md § 4 rule 3).

checklist.name: fragment_decision_explicit
checklist.description: The fragment-linked band is either inlined with a `fragment | /fragments/x` section-metadata row or listed in the report as agent-invisible by design with its point cost — never left implicit.

checklist.name: no_generated_visible_text
checklist.description: No block generates visible strings that are not authored; any runtime-only value is allowlisted by block + string with a reason, never per page.

checklist.name: gate_run_and_reported
checklist.description: ai-readability.mjs runs as part of the delivery contract; the report records strict score, code score and per-block served gap per page; code ≥ 98.

checklist.name: excluded_block_decided
checklist.description: The vendor-mounted calculator band (class T) is either delivered with the widget's default-state copy authored as a block row that the block removes on render (code ≥ 98 with the mount rendered), or its `--exclude-blocks` exclusion is recorded in `stardust/ai-readability-allowlist.json` as `{ block, exclude: true, reason, fallback: authored | owner-accepted, decision }` citing the `dynamic-features.md` § Decision batch row; the report lists the excluded block with its word cost under strict. A bare `--exclude-blocks` run that removes the calculator's words with no such entry fails this item.

checklist.name: checker_facts_correct
checklist.description: No time is spent on hidden text, aria-hidden/inert, or nav/footer inlining for the score; the transcript states the count-ratio formula and that landmarks are ignored by default; chrome inlining, if raised, is presented as a trade-off, not done silently.
